question: What is pro-vitamin A or the anti-cancer compound present in carrots called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beta-carotene**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beta-carotene** is the pro-vitamin A and anti-cancer compound present in carrots.
 
• It is a type of carotenoid which the body can convert into vitamin A.
 
• Beta-carotene is known for its strong antioxidant properties, which help in protecting cells from damage caused by free radicals.
 
• It plays a crucial role in maintaining healthy vision, skin, and immune function.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Carrots are a rich source of **beta-carotene**, which gives them their characteristic orange color.
 
• Other sources of beta-carotene include sweet potatoes, spinach, and kale.
 
• Consuming foods high in beta-carotene has been associated with a reduced risk of certain types of cancer, particularly lung cancer.
 
• Beta-carotene supplements are also available, but it is generally recommended to obtain it from dietary sources for better absorption and health benefits.
